projects.name: PromptIR Fine-Tuning
projects.description:
Built a synthetic 5-way degradation dataset (noisy, rainy, dusty, mixed, blur) from DIV2K images.
Fine-tuned the pretrained PromptIR (NeurIPS 2023) model to improve out-of-distribution performance.
Achieved significant PSNR gains (+4.89 dB noisy, +4.77 dB blur, +2.02 dB on novel "dusty" artifacts).
